background: AIB Group is the holding company of Allied Irish Banks, one of Ireland's two dominant retail and business banks, funded by Irish deposits and lending mainly on Irish mortgages and to Irish companies.
synthesis: Only one of the three main agencies rates the group, at BBB+ on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade on 6 Nov 2025. Capital and liquidity are both strong: CET1 of 16.4% and leverage of 6.7% are above their peer medians, and LCR of 204% and NSFR of 158% are both in the top quarter. Since 30 Jun 2024 CET1 has risen 0.9 points and leverage has fallen 0.8 points, with NSFR down 7 points since 30 Jun 2025 and LCR broadly flat (figures to 31 Mar 2026). The only item flagged in the last 90 days, on 31 Jul 2026, is a record first-half profit.
